# 06 Wire core class diagrams into render(), add demo

## Outcome

`render()` recognizes a `classDiagram` document and runs
`buildClassModel → layoutClassDiagram → renderClassDiagramToSVG → createAnimationController`,
returning a working controller (class diagrams animate — unlike sequence diagrams, which return
`null`). A new `demos/class-diagram.html` renders it against the real Vite bundle.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `render()` on a real `classDiagram` source mounts an SVG and returns `diagnostics: []` for
  valid input.
- [ ] `render()` on `flowchart` and `sequenceDiagram` sources is unaffected.
- [ ] A relationship naming an undeclared class renders it implicitly, end to end, with no
  diagnostic — the canonical `Animal <|-- Duck` document works with no `class` statements.
- [ ] `render()` returns a non-null `controller` for a class diagram, with `totalSteps` 0 when the
  document has no `timeline:` block. (Full timeline behavior is ticket 15; this pins that the
  controller exists rather than being `null` like sequence's.)
- [ ] `demos/class-diagram.html` renders a core class diagram in a browser, following
  `demos/sequence-diagram.html`'s structure (fetch an `examples/*.srn`, theme toggle).

## Test seam

`render(source, container, options?): SirenRenderResult` — integration test under jsdom.
